content: यक्षः [यक्ष्यते, यक्ष्-कर्मणि घञ्] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a class of demigods who are described as attendants of Kubera, the god of riches, and employed in guarding his gardens and treasures; यक्षोत्तमा यक्षपतिं धनेशं रक्षन्ति वै प्रासगदादिहस्ताः <ls>Hariv.</ls>; <ls>Me. 68</ls>; <ls>Bg. 10. 23</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">11. 22</ls>. .²2 A kind of ghost or spirit; तन्न व्यजानन्त किमिदं यक्षमिति <ls>Ken. 3. 2</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the palace of Indra. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Kubera. .²5 Worship. .²6 A dog. .{@-क्षम्@} .²1 A ghost. .²2 Sacrifice. .²3 Anything honoured. .{@-क्षी@} .²1 A female Yakṣa. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Kuberaʼs wife. .²3 The Yakṣa class; अल्पवीर्या यदा यक्षी श्रूयते मुनिपुंगव <ls>Rām. 1. 25. 2</ls>.
